title: Payment due date reminder
description: A WhatsApp payment reminder template for banks and lenders: invoice amount, due date and a pay link. Utility category, ready to copy.
notes: Keep it strictly informational: mention the amount and due date only, no cross-sell or discount, or Meta may move it to marketing. Send 2 to 3 days before the due date for best pay rates.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, this is a reminder that your installment of *{{amount}}* for loan {{loan_id}} is due on _{{due_date}}_. Paying on time keeps your account in good standing.
